title: TrackerInboxRowAsk
responsibility: Shows one needs-you row's answer choices and records the tapped choice for the revision that row shows.

inputs.name: TrackerInboxRowAsk.source
inputs.description: Tracker connection that records the answer, on the Mac directly or queued through the phone.

inputs.name: TrackerInboxRowAsk.review
inputs.description: The read this row shows; a tap answers its revision, or is refused if the item moved on.

inputs.name: TrackerInboxRowAsk.mode
inputs.description: Whether the row runs in the Mac app or the iPhone app, which sets the write path and its messages.

inputs.name: TrackerInboxRowAsk.onchanged
inputs.description: Re-reads the Tracker after an answer is written.

inputs.name: TrackerInboxRowAsk.onsent
inputs.description: Receives the confirmation text, so the list can show it after the answered row leaves.

outputs.name: TrackerInboxRowAsk
outputs.description: The row's choice buttons, with Other opening a modal for a written answer.
